summary:
Final walkthrough for Sprint 5: Research Miner Finalization, Security Hardening, SurrealDB Automation, and RLM Integration.
Documents the successful implementation of the Nexus Research Miner, refined PromptGuard heuristics, automated SurrealDB systemd service, and the new Recursive Language Model (RLM) paradigm for deep-context research.
Includes verification results for each component.
